title.title: The McBee Dynasty: Real American Cowboys
title.overview: The high-stakes ranching and farming world of McBee Farm & Cattle is on the brink of becoming either a billion-dollar business or a financial disaster.

episodes.name: Family Succession
episodes.overview: McBee Farm is about to be worth a billion dollars; Steve must entrust its future to one of his sons.

episodes.name: 100 Million-Dollar Love Triangle
episodes.overview: Steve's love triangle with CFO Galyna and Brooke threatens the future of the farm.

episodes.name: Busted
episodes.overview: Galyna's discovery that Steve is having an affair with Brooke could mean the end of the farm.

episodes.name: An Ultimatum
episodes.overview: Galyna issues Steve an ultimatum, and he must decide between Brooke and keeping Galyna as his CFO.

episodes.name: The Wild, Wild West
episodes.overview: The McBees travel to Montana for Bison and connect to the land with their Indigenous American hosts.

episodes.name: Power Moves and Paying Dues
episodes.overview: Galyna uses her leverage on the pending venture capital deal to move into Steve's house permanently.

episodes.name: Nashville Hot
episodes.overview: The brothers get in trouble with their girlfriends when Steve insists on a boys' trip to Nashville.

episodes.name: The Women Strike Back
episodes.overview: The farm's women throw a revenge party; Galyna gets alarming news about the venture capital deal.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.overview: With Steve dating other women and the venture capital deal in danger, Galyna is at a breaking point.

episodes.name: Worst Case Scenario
episodes.overview: Steve spirals out of control with the capital deal dead in the water; Galyna confronts Brooke.

episodes.name: Russian Roulette
episodes.overview: Eldest brother Steven has a plan to save the farm from financial ruin, but younger brother Cole has his own idea on what's best.

episodes.name: Ditched for Dallas
episodes.overview: The truth as to why Calah has been estranged from the family is revealed, forcing her to make a choice; Kristi, the McBee's mother and ex-wife to their father, joins her sons to help them through their time of need.

episodes.name: The Great Chicken Massacre
episodes.overview: Calah and Steven's relationship takes a surprising turn; Galyna finds out her former best friend, Masha, is on a romantic getaway in Mexico with her ex, Steve Sr.; Jesse gives Alli, his bride-to-be, an ultimatum.

episodes.name: Day Drinkin'
episodes.overview: When Steven suspects Galyna of drinking on the job, he plans a mediation with Masha in the hopes of ending their feud and getting the business back on track.

episodes.name: Hurricane Calah
episodes.overview: The McBee family is met with nostalgia as they arrive at their favorite vacation destination, Lake of the Ozarks. A fun day of paintballing and day-drinking at the pool leads to a massive blow-up that threatens any future that Steven and Calah may have. Tension between Cole and Kacie arise when Kacie questions just how much Cole has changed.

episodes.name: Never Seen a Rock So Big
episodes.overview: Cole sets out to win Kacie back after his poor behavior in the Ozarks with a surprise babymoon, but it may be at the cost of saving the farm. Steven runs into trouble with a potential business partner and looks to his mother to get Galyna's head back in the game.

episodes.name: Nashville Hot
episodes.overview: The McBee brothers get into hot water with their girlfriends when Steve insists on a bacchanal boys' trip to Nashville to get away from Galyna; Steve reveals he has another girlfriend.

episodes.name: Panic! On the Combine
episodes.overview: When out harvesting, Jesse suffers from intense panic attacks as his wedding day draws closer; Cole goes ring shopping for Kacie; Steven invites a surprise guest to the wedding.

episodes.name: Russian Invasion
episodes.overview: Galyna vies for an invitation to Jesse and Alli's wedding; claws come out when Masha invades Galyna's work event; Jesse wonders whether to ask Alli for a prenup.

episodes.name: Wedding Bells And Jail Cells
episodes.overview: Jesse and Alli’s big day has arrived. Galyna throws Jesse and Alli’s wedding day into a fit of chaos when she has a troubling encounter with the police. An update to the FBI’s investigation is revealed. The newest member of the McBee Family arrives.

episodes.name: Judgment Day
episodes.overview: After pleading guilty in an FBI crop insurance fraud investigation,?the patriarch of the McBee family is sentenced,?leaving the farm’s future in jeopardy. Steven brings home a new girlfriend. Cole prepares to step up on the farm?amid financial worries. Galyna’s absence at the farm leaves the brothers skeptical.

episodes.name: Night Of The Living Russians
episodes.overview: When Cole attempts to bail the farm out of debt, Steven is left wondering if he can balance the business and his new relationship. Galyna and Masha go head-to-head at the family’s annual Halloween party following surprising security footage from the ranch.

episodes.name: Cash-strapped Cash Cow
episodes.overview: The McBee boys head to Iowa for a cattle auction. With Steven absent, Jesse and Cole question his commitment to the farm over his new relationship. Cole and Kacie face a setback in their relationship. Masha tries to ingratiate herself with the McBee women.

episodes.name: Love And War
episodes.overview: Cole plans an epic proposal for Kacie. Alli confides in Kacie about the lack of intimacy in her marriage. Following a run-in with Steve’s ex-girlfriend, Galyna attempts to hash out her issues with Masha.

episodes.name: Business Beef
episodes.overview: Steven makes waves when he tries to give his new girlfriend a cut of Kacie’s beef tallow business. Alli confronts Jesse about their marital issues. Masha enlists an unlikely ally to help her with a photoshoot.

similar.title: Police 24/7
similar.subtitle: 2024 • TV-14
similar.overview: This adrenaline-packed series delivers raw, unfiltered access into the world of sheriffs and police departments across the United States as they serve and protect at all costs. From drug busts to routine traffic stops, you never know what to expect, but these officers are ready 24/7 to keep their communities safe.

similar.title: Mystery Files
similar.overview: Have you ever found yourself on a Wikipedia deep dive on the weird side of the internet? In this show, weird thing enthusiasts Ryan and Shane take turns presenting their latest fascinations to each other covering everything unusual, unexplained, and unhinged.

similar.title: Dimension 20
similar.overview: Heed the call of adventure and enter Dimension 20 where Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan, joined by comedians and pro gamers, blends comedy with tabletop RPGs.
